feed.title: U.S. District Court, District of Maine — CM/ECF Docket Entries (public RSS)
feed.subtitle: The court's public CM/ECF RSS feed (verified live on the court's CourtInfo page): recent docket entries of type order/order-cr from the last 24 hours, free without a PACER login. Highest-frequency signal source for federal litigators. The upstream window is only 24 hours deep, so items rotate out quickly; the archive feed preserves them.
